extra.message: DOCTYPE declarations are enabled for this SAXParserFactory. This is vulnerable to XML external entity attacks. Disable this by setting the feature `http://apache.org/xml/features/disallow-doctype-decl` to true. Alternatively, allow DOCTYPE declarations and only prohibit external entities declarations. This can be done by setting the features `http://xml.org/sax/features/external-general-entities` and `http://xml.org/sax/features/external-parameter-entities` to false. NOTE - The previous links are not meant to be clicked. They are the literal config key values that are supposed to be used to disable these features. For more information, see https://semgrep.dev/docs/cheat-sheets/java-xxe/#3a-documentbuilderfactory.
